name: sprint_planning
transcript: Arjun: Good morning. Let's go through the sprint board.
Divya: The login page redesign is done. I'll start the password reset flow tomorrow.
Arjun: Nice. Karthik, please review the API documentation by Wednesday.
Karthik: Will do. I also need to fix the failing unit tests before Friday.
Divya: We have a demo with the client next week.
Arjun: Right. Meera, can you prepare the demo slides by next Tuesday?
Meera: Yes, I'll have them ready by 17 November.

name: marketing_sync
transcript: Nisha: Thanks for joining. Quick updates on the campaign first.
Rohan: Instagram engagement is up twelve percent. I will send the weekly report to Nisha by end of day.
Nisha: Great. Sana, could you draft the newsletter by Friday?
Sana: Sure, I'll share the draft on Thursday.
Rohan: Should we increase the ad budget?
Nisha: Let's decide that next meeting. Rohan, please collect the competitor pricing data by 2026-11-11.

gold.task: Send the weekly report to Nisha

name: engineering_standup
transcript: Vikram: Let's keep this short. Any blockers?
Pooja: The database migration is blocked. Ishaan needs to approve my pull request today.
Ishaan: I'll review it after lunch.
Vikram: Pooja, you should also update the deployment checklist this week.
Ishaan: I'm going to look into the memory leak and share my findings on Thursday.
Pooja: Someone should talk to the infra team about the new servers.

Talk to the infra team about the new servers

name: vendor_onboarding_discussion
transcript: Manoj: Okay, status on the vendor onboarding?
Shreya: We are waiting on the contract. I'll follow up with legal on Monday.
Manoj: Do we know when the new laptops arrive?
Shreya: They should arrive next week, so Pranav will set up accounts before they arrive.
Pranav: Right. I need to finish the security checklist by Tuesday.
Manoj: Also, someone has to update the onboarding guide, it's outdated.
Shreya: I'll take it.

name: release_check
transcript: Kavya: Final check before the release. Rahul, please update the changelog in 3 days.
Rahul: Sure. Kavya, can you tag the release by end of the week?
Kavya: I'll tag it on Friday, and I will email the QA team tomorrow.
